research_goal: Investigate why fountainchans-projects reached 7.5GB+ Fast Origin Transfer on Vercel Hobby tier and provide concrete fixes.

objects: Vercel Hobby Plan (10GB Fast Origin Transfer limit)
exclusions: Upgrading to Pro as sole solution without technical remediation
assumptions: Usage alert is team-wide across 7 projects

format_basis.name: Vercel Fast Origin Transfer Diagnostic & Optimization Guide
format_basis.credibility_reason: Vercel Official Docs on CDN Pricing and Usage
what_extracted: Fast Origin Transfer definition (ingress+egress on compute/blobs/middleware)
Mitigation levers (middleware matcher, edge caching, image unoptimized impact, payload reduction)

sections: 一、执行摘要：75% 预警的真实含义与紧急风险
二、根因拆解：Fast Origin Transfer 为什么会消耗 7.5GB+
三、项目与代码层面的高风险点深度审计
四、系统级优化与防穿透方案（按投入产出比排序）
五、立即可执行的操作清单（Checklist）与监控建议
mandatory_elements: 高风险代码与优化对比表
立即可执行的改造清单
report_shape.style: 严谨技术分析、清晰结论、代码级实操建议

completion_criteria: 全面阐述 Vercel Fast Origin Transfer 的计量机制
结合本仓库及 team 下多项目架构精准定位 4 大主要流量泄漏点
给出代码级、配置级与 CDN 级改造方案

dimensions.name: Vercel 计量机制与计费口径研究

key_questions: 与 Fast Data Transfer 有何区别？

dimensions.name: 代码库架构与潜在泄漏点审计

key_questions: Middleware matcher 是否拦截了不必要资源？

dimensions.name: Team 范围多项目协同与外部反代分析

key_questions: Cloudflare 反代为何依然产生 Fast Origin Transfer？
